raidNotes: In this hack, you will be able to battle Pokémon in Raid Dens. Those Dens are located in many places, and you will encounter different Pokémon depending on the Raid Den.

If the Raid Den is active, the Pokémon inside might change every hour. However, after battling the Pokémon inside, even if you lose, the Den will be deactivated. Dens regenerate after you throw a Wishing Piece inside.

The difficulty of the Raid Battle depends on the Pokémon inside the Den and the number of Stars shown in the Raid menu, ranging from 1-6 Stars. In select Dens, Legendary Pokémon may appear in 3, 4, 5 or 6-Stars Raids. The level of the Pokémon also depends on the number of Stars.
The number of Stars that a Raid Den can have depends on your Gym Badge count. The table below shows the possible number of Stars depending on Gym Badge count.
After Entering Hall of Fame: ★★★★★ or ★★★★★★
fossilNotes: Trade shards with a Hiker in the Vermilion City Fanclub to obtain a Fossil Pokémon.
The fossils that you find in Mt. Moon/Pewter City can be revived by a Scientist in the same building.
That Hiker can sell you the other Fossil Pokémon that you didn't choose in Mt. Moon.
For Galarian Fossil Pokémon, refer to the "Grass & Caves" and "Raid Dens" tabs.

mysteryGiftNotes: To input these codes, talk to the red Nurse in any Pokémon Center and select the "Mystery Gift" option.
You may only claim those rewards after entering the Hall Of Fame at least once.
Those codes are case-sensitive and the rewards can only be redeemed once per save file.
They will never expire. Most Mystery Gifts can be inputted in v3.1 even released after that version.
Pokémon distributed through Mystery Gifts are always Lv. 85.
